page.overview:
Who is Azure Fang?

She has a curious and fun-loving personality and is compassionate as well. She is determined to heal incurable diseases in the ninja world. She enjoys cleansing short blades and bathing.

Her techniques are based on Water Release techniques, along with use of poison and Medical Ninjutsu. Her forte lies in chakra control. She is a user of senjutsu, but has no specific techniques associated with it.

Azure Fang is one of the five player avatars available in the game. They work through the plot of Naruto and Naruto: Shippūden alongside the main characters.
